mapper.sql: -- 根据用户ID查询所有有效权限（考虑部门继承、岗位、用户直连） WITH user_subjects AS ( -- 1. 用户主体本身 SELECT 'USER' AS sub_type, #{userId} AS sub_id UNION ALL -- 2. 用户所属部门及其所有上级部门 (实现部门继承) SELECT 'DEPT' AS sub_type, dc.ancestor_id AS sub_id FROM user_dept ud JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL -- 3. 用户所属岗位 SELECT 'POST' AS sub_type, up.post_id AS sub_id FROM user_post up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.status = 0 -- 4. 未来扩展：在此处 UNION ALL 增加 PROJECT 或其他主体即可 -- UNION ALL SELECT 'PROJECT', project_id FROM user_project ... )

user_roles AS (SELECT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt WHERE gt.subject_type = 'USER' AND gt.subject_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT gt . role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_dept ud ON ud . dept_id = gt . subject_id WHERE gt . subject_type = 'DEPT' AND ud . user_id = #{userId} AND ud . status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT gt . role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_post up ON up . post_id = gt . subject_id WHERE gt . subject_type = 'POST' AND up . user_id = #{userId} AND ( up . status IS NULL OR up . status = 0 ) )

SELECT DISTINCT gt.subject_id AS uid FROM grant_table gt WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ud.user_id AS uid FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_dept ud ON ud.dept_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT up.user_id AS uid FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_post up ON up.post_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'POST' AND (up.status IS NULL OR up.status = 0)
